message:
I only have a few minutes before my next call. João cooks at the Old Mill Hall. Karim leases the plot of land by the river. Also, Kavya rents the vineyard near Sibiu. Nour Mansour cooks at the Lisbon Arena. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

The school bus is not repaired by Hao. Ioana is a member of the youth choir. Mirela leases the holiday cottage in Bran. Also, Petronela rents the recording studio.

The white camper van is repaired by Răzvan Ungureanu. Rémi grows lavender. Also, Diego García grows grapevines. Ji-woo plants strawberries. The warehouse forklift is repaired by Cosmin Dumitrescu.

Emma plants basil. Chen Liu does not cook at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Giorgos is a member of the opera chorus. Liviu Anghel is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Nairobi.

Dorin Florea is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Alexandria. Also, Lucian doesn't cook at the Oradea Arena. Brândușa cooks at the Botanical Garden in Târgu Mureș. Also, Matei Enache cooks at the Kraków Philharmonic. Ms Stoica is the chef at the Lyon Arena. Ruxandra is the chef at the Iași Arena.

Thảo doesn't cook at the Piatra Neamț Philharmonic. Kenji cooks at the Bălți Arena. Cătălin cooks at the Botanical Garden in Ploiești. Viorica is not the chef at the Constanța Philharmonic. Also, Ngozi is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Lviv.

Jürgen cooks at the Cahul Arena. I only have a few minutes before my next call. Esmeralda does not cook at the Botanical Garden in Sibiu. Also, Javier cooks at the Slatina Arena.

A few questions, then: Do you know if the yellow taxi isn't repaired by Roxana? I believe the old Volvo is repaired by Florică. Is it repaired by Florică, do you know? Do you know until when Csaba rented the old sailing boat? Any idea who sings in the folk ensemble? Is it the case that Megan grows sunflowers?

message:
I only have a few minutes before my next call. Wojciech plants peppers. Sigrid is a member of the opera chorus.

Nadiya sings in the chamber choir. Also, Hao is a member of the Madrigal choir. Mr Anghel plants pumpkins. Also, Lukas grows grapevines. Łukasz Wójcik sings in the folk ensemble. Also, Ghiță Stoian sings in the church choir.

Dariush is not the chef at the Reșița Arena. Grace leases the red Dacia. Nour sings in the youth choir. I will try to keep the rest short. Alexandru Vlădescu is a member of the university choir.

The school bus is repaired by Nikos. Also, the fire engine is repaired by Vikram. Veaceslav grows strawberries. Also, Mr Martínez plants tomatoes. The warehouse forklift is not repaired by Larissa. Also, the hospital ambulance is repaired by Tunde Okafor. Mr Li doesn't cook at the Kraków Arena. Also, Min-jun cooks at the Botanical Garden in Galați. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Thomas is not the chef at the Orhei Arena. Also, Giorgos is the chef at the Târgu Mureș Philharmonic.

Rubina doesn't cook at the Osaka Arena. Also, Aiko Watanabe cooks at the Botanical Garden in Buzău. Ji-woo cooks at the Botanical Garden in Tampere. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Alina is not the chef at the Botanical Garden in Porto. Also, Viorel is not the chef at the Botanical Garden in Cahul. Irina leases the plot of land by the river. Taras leases the old sailing boat. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Kenji doesn't cook at the Botanical Garden in Oradea. Also, Lucía is the chef at the Glasgow Philharmonic. Otieno Odhiambo isn't the chef at the Leipzig Arena. Also, Maria is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Tulcea. Brândușa does not cook at the Pune Philharmonic. Mr Dobre is the chef at the Lyon Arena.

Bianca cooks at the Botanical Garden in Nairobi. Also, Elif Çelik does not cook at the Montreal Philharmonic. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Parisa Tehrani is the chef at the Recife Philharmonic. Samuel cooks at the Botoșani Philharmonic. Also, Traian cooks at the Botanical Garden in Szeged. Wei is the chef at the Plovdiv Arena.

Cătălin Rusu cooks at the Baia Mare Arena. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here.

What I actually want to know:
Here's what I know: Iancu plants lavender. Does he grow lavender or not?
Suppose Mr Adeyemi cooks at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Is it the case that George cooks at the Community Centre on Elm Street?
Remind me, what does Ethan grow?
Could you check if Mihai is the chef at the Iași Arena? I'm asking because Ildikó Tóth cooks at the Iași Arena.
Suppose Hassan cooks at the Piatra Neamț Philharmonic. Is he the chef at the Piatra Neamț Philharmonic or not?
Could you check if the yellow taxi is repaired by Enikő?

message:
Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. The white camper van is repaired by Joaquín. Also, the school bus is repaired by Petru. Liam is the chef at the Izmir Arena. Paloma plants tomatoes. Giorgos grows apple trees. Also, Ana plants basil.

The delivery van is not repaired by Zsófia. Min-jun Choi leases the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. The yellow taxi is repaired by Hao Zhao. Also, the hospital ambulance is repaired by Mr Ciobanu. Fatima sings in the gospel choir. Also, Iancu is a member of the folk ensemble. Manon plants strawberries.

Rohan cooks at the Sighișoara Philharmonic. Also, Valentina is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Valencia. Théo Bernard grows sunflowers. Elif doesn't rent the blue van. Thomas is not the chef at the Constanța Arena. Taras doesn't cook at the Târgu Mureș Philharmonic. Also, Xiaoling is the chef at the Leipzig Philharmonic.

Bohdan is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Pune. Also, Octavian is the chef at the Montreal Arena. Cristina Oprea is the chef at the Lagos Arena. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused.

Gheorghe Barbu is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Slatina. Also, Daria cooks at the Botanical Garden in Alba Iulia. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask.

Here is what I would like to check:
Who leases the red Dacia, if you know?
So who plants roses?
Is the fire engine repaired by Nicolae Sârbu or not?
Suppose Mirela Tănase is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Vaslui. Does she cook at the Botanical Garden in Vaslui, do you know?
So how many venues is Luminița the chef at?
"Cătălin Căpraru is the chef at the Bălți Arena" — does that hold?

message:
I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. The hospital ambulance is repaired by Amira Nasser. Also, the red tractor is repaired by Zsófia Szabó. Zoltán doesn't sing in the Madrigal choir. The weather here has been awful all week. Emma Wilson leases the old sailing boat. Also, Tunde leases the blue van.

Tudor grows grapevines. Mihai rents the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. The white camper van is repaired by Sigrid.

The delivery van is repaired by Camille. Also, the warehouse forklift is not repaired by Meera. The yellow taxi is repaired by Alejandro Navarro. The old Volvo is repaired by Parisa. Csaba is a member of the opera chorus. Also, Priya Reddy doesn't sing in the youth choir. Veaceslav is a member of the church choir. Mr Georgiou cooks at the Cahul Arena. Also, Megan Walker is not the chef at the Old Mill Hall.

Mr Kaya sings in the chamber choir. Yan leases the holiday cottage in Bran. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Agnieszka is not the chef at the Community Centre on Elm Street. I will try to keep the rest short. Nour is the chef at the Valencia Philharmonic.

Thomas doesn't lease the vineyard near Sibiu. I hope you are having a good day. Viorica Tănase is the chef at the Timișoara Philharmonic. Florin cooks at the Botanical Garden in Tulcea. Also, Diego cooks at the Botoșani Arena. Luminița rents the recording studio.

Aiko Suzuki rents the bakery on the corner. Also, Jun rents the garage behind the block. Thảo Trần cooks at the Craiova Arena. Also, Tatiana is the chef at the Hanoi Philharmonic. Hao doesn't rent the plot of land by the river. Also, Can leases the red Dacia. Thanks for your patience with all my questions.

Min-jun is the chef at the Slatina Philharmonic. Carmen is the chef at the Thessaloniki Philharmonic.

Help me with this one: does Matei grow strawberries?
Does Otilia plant lavender, do you know?
Remind me, how many venues does Mr Voicu cook at?

Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Manon rents the red Dacia. The red tractor is repaired by Nikos. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Hannah cooks at the Tampere Arena. Also, Constantin is the chef at the Brașov Arena. Théo Moreau does not lease the plot of land by the river. Also, Ms Sánchez leases the holiday cottage in Bran. Botond rents the old sailing boat. The fire engine is repaired by Emma Turner.

Élodie is a member of the Madrigal choir. The hospital ambulance is repaired by Dragoș. Also, the white camper van is repaired by Minh. Thomas grows sunflowers. Also, Daria grows peppers. Csaba Kovács is the chef at the Valencia Arena.

Cosmin is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Bălți. Natalia cooks at the Botanical Garden in Arad. Mykola Melnyk grows tomatoes. Also, Chioma grows basil. Ștefania is the chef at the Alexandria Arena. Mircea is the chef at the Târgu Mureș Philharmonic. Also, Diego cooks at the Lisbon Philharmonic.

Now, what I need to know: Not counting Wojciech, please find out who grows lavender. According to Mr Căpraru, Kavya Patel leases the vineyard near Sibiu. Any chance she rents the vineyard near Sibiu? Could you check if Mehmet cooks at the Novi Sad Arena? So which choir does Mr Țurcanu sing in?

That is all the background I have for now.

Luminița lectures in drawing. Also, Ms Martínez does not lecture in chemistry. Sânziana looks after the login service. Also, Ilinca Iordache looks after the mail server. Csaba resides in Tampere.

From what date on is Attila on the payroll of Blue Harbor Media?
How many subjects does Ethan Bennett lecture in, if you know?

Cheers, and have a nice evening.

message:
I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Tatiana plays for CS Orhei. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious.

Lucian looks after the payroll database. Also, Tamás looks after the reporting dashboard. Veaceslav attends the product launch. The code review session takes place at the Botanical Garden in Buzău. Also, the parents' evening doesn't take place at the Old Mill Hall. Mihai treats Carmen Navarro. My coffee went cold while I was typing this.

Șerban & Partners carries school uniforms. Nils is allergic to cat hair. Diego is not based in Brașov.

Ildikó Tóth does not treat Krzysztof. Also, Anna-Lena treats Ion. Carpathia Energy published Letters to a Young Engineer. Also, Blue Harbor Media did not publish Winter in Maramureș. Hassan does not plan to go to the spring book fair. Also, Bohdan Shevchenko intends to attend the Tuesday board meeting. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious. Nordwind Systems employs Ms Turner.

Ms Ungureanu treats Yan. Wojciech is based in Vaslui. Adaeze doesn't report to Min-jun Lee.

Paula is not on Olimpia Focșani. Chengdu Logistics published The Clockmaker's Daughter. Also, Greenline Transport published Notes from the Night Train. A land title extract is required for a residence certificate. Also, a driving licence requires a medical certificate. Zsófia Balogh plans to study physical education. Also, Viorel plans to study piano. Ingrid is a child of Liviu. Also, Silviu is a child of Mei.

Mykola does not plan to study mathematics. Also, Botond wants to learn geography. Meera Reddy flies to Hanoi. Also, Minh Trần flies to Debrecen. Delta Print employs Otilia Manole. Katrin is a child of Takumi.

Thomas is not based in Plovdiv. Also, Bogdan lives in Suceava. Ms Khalil trains the Cluj-Napoca Falcons. Also, Gábor trains the Pitești Falcons. Emeka reports to Javier. Also, Cătălin Rădulescu reports to Constantin. Elif plans to study history. Iași Logistics is a supplier of Pătrașcu & Partners.

Smith & Partners carries olive oil. Also, Anghel & Partners carries garden furniture. Sofía Romero is allergic to strawberries. It has been a hectic week on my side. Aurel is based in Deva.

Ms Martin is the spouse of Ngozi. Parisa does not live in Lisbon. Zofia doesn't have an allergy to latex.

Any chance Mr Liu was on Rapid Timișoara during 2019? Any idea since when Eleni trains the Valencia Wolves? Here's what I know: Petru is trained and Elena has completed the safety training. Any chance Doina Stan doesn't complete the safety training? Not counting Lena, please find out who is on Rapid Busan. Fact-check: Giorgos borrowed The Salt Road.

Thanks in advance!

message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Sophie plans to study physics. The Osaka Town Hall is located in Reșița. Also, Orion Robotics is located in Timișoara. Bohdan trains CS Leipzig.

Carpathia Energy did not publish The Salt Road. Adaeze is the spouse of Mehmet. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me.

Mr Romero is married to Ștefan Diaconu. Also, Ghiță is married to Florin. The Tuesday board meeting takes place at the Lviv Philharmonic. Joaquín doesn't fly to Chengdu. Ovidiu does not plan to go to the harvest festival.

Mihai has an allergy to peanuts. Also, Teodora Vlădescu is allergic to dust mites. Medeea wants to learn computer science. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Roxana is not allergic to bee stings. Also, Krzysztof has an allergy to penicillin.

Blue Harbor Media is a supplier of Delta Print. Also, Nordwind Systems is a supplier of Vertex Analytics. The analytics pipeline does not depend on the login service. Also, the mail server does not depend on the backup cluster. Petru checked out Winter in Maramureș. Also, Elif Demir borrowed The Last Ferry. Atelier Weber sells garden furniture.

Thomas does not go to Deva Technical College. Felix has an allergy to pollen. Also, Priya isn't allergic to latex. The spring book fair takes place at the Old Mill Hall. Also, the town hall debate takes place at the Botanical Garden in Novi Sad. Achieng looks after the payroll database. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. The Botanical Garden in Pitești isn't located in Sibiu.

Nikos Georgiou trains the Slatina Wolves. A work permit requires an ID card. Also, a driving licence requires a medical certificate. Hanoi Logistics is a supplier of Bergen Logistics. Oprea & Partners does not sell baby food. I hope you are having a good day.

Ms Bălan reports to Mykola. Also, João reports to Kavya. Parisa looks after the VPN gateway. Also, Arjun Iyer looks after the booking app. Atelier Munteanu sells winter tyres. Chioma is a child of Ilinca. Mr Florea plans to study drawing.

Oksana doesn't want to learn biology. Mr Szabó goes to Izmir Music Academy. Levente Farkas reports to Grace. The Nairobi Philharmonic is located in Debrecen. Also, the Botanical Garden in Debrecen is located in Bacău. Małgorzata treats Traian. Also, Mr Martin treats Natalia.

Astrid Nilsen looks after the search index. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. The inventory API relies on the payments gateway. Horia goes to Sighișoara Technical College. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Simona does not teach Spanish. Also, Ms Wright gives classes in mathematics.

Kraków Logistics does not employ Wei.

Now, what I need to know:
So where did the product launch take place?
So where did Xiaoling fly?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Karim teaches physical education. Also, Thiago doesn't give classes in drawing. A land title extract is required for a work permit. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.

Mr Moreau owns the old sailing boat. A building permit requires an ID card. The Alexandria Land Office issues a residence certificate. Also, the Passport Office in Călărași issues a criminal record certificate. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Florică is a child of Ms Farkas. Also, Javier López is a child of Mr Mansour. Amira wrote The Last Ferry. Brândușa Crăciun doesn't own the vineyard near Sibiu. Noah is not a child of Teodora.

Silviu owns the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. Also, Ildikó Varga does not own the garage behind the block. The weather here has been awful all week. A fire safety approval is issued by the Nairobi Town Hall. Also, the Lyon Tax Office issues a medical certificate. Ethan is the spouse of Ovidiu. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. The Botanical Garden in Alba Iulia is located in Constanța.

Things I still have to do today:
- pay the phone bill
- finish the slides
- call the plumber
- answer my emails
- water the plants

A few questions, then: Any idea how Min-jun Choi settles the bill? Here's what I know: Paloma Martínez gets the flu shot, and Alina is vaccinated against the flu. Do you know if Lucian doesn't get the flu shot? Any idea which event takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street? Here's what I know: Lars reports to Thomas. Is it the case that Thomas reports to Lars?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. The Tuesday board meeting doesn't take place at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Also, the product launch takes place at the Old Mill Hall. Sigrid lives in Lisbon. Thiago owns the old sailing boat. Ethan Taylor is based in Piatra Neamț. Also, Chen lives in Chengdu. Cătălin is allergic to lactose.

Karim does not live in Nairobi. Also, Mr Nagy is based in Galați. Atelier Vlădescu carries school uniforms. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Mr Szabó goes to Busan Arts High School. Bogdan-Ionuț Voicu does not go to the Kraków Language School. Iancu is married to Diego López. Atelier Varga is a supplier of Varga & Partners. A driving licence requires a birth certificate.

Alexandru Tănase looks after the payroll database.

Things I still have to do today:
- buy groceries
- answer my emails
- pay the phone bill
- call the plumber

Now, what I need to know:
Fact-check: Oluwaseun plans to go to the parents' evening.

message:
We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. A passport is issued by the Piatra Neamț Land Office. Carmen flies to Busan. Karim teaches piano. Also, Diego teaches computer science. The reporting dashboard relies on the mail server. Also, the analytics pipeline relies on the login service.

The wedding reception doesn't take place at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Also, the Tuesday board meeting doesn't take place at the Constanța Arena. A fire safety approval isn't issued by the Cahul Town Hall. Thiago has borrowed The Quiet Harbour. Also, Tunde has borrowed The Glass Orchard. Ji-woo Lee is not a child of Lars Andersen. Also, Théo is a child of Ghiță. Bohdan does not plan to study history. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Petronela Anghel is the spouse of Veaceslav Guțu. Also, Luminița is married to Otilia. Nordwind Systems employs Mr Georgiou. Also, Atelier Rădulescu employs Mr García. Tisa Textiles is a supplier of Mureșan & Partners. Also, Orion Robotics is a supplier of Hughes & Partners. Oliver wants to learn Spanish. Also, Paloma does not want to learn geography. Atelier Lazăr is a supplier of Carpathia Energy. Ms Girard wants to learn physical education.

Léa looks after the inventory API. Also, Iurie Rotaru looks after the payments gateway. Popa Primary School isn't located in Arad. Also, Nistor Primary School is located in Sighișoara. Anna-Lena treats Gábor. Lukas is a child of Kenji Watanabe. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Barbu & Partners employs Petru. Also, Brightfield Foods employs Fatima. Can goes to Vaslui Arts High School. Saint Luke Hospital is located in Thessaloniki. Also, Sibiu Logistics is not located in Glasgow. Atelier Wilson is a supplier of Atelier Popescu. Also, Atelier Ionescu is a supplier of Debrecen Logistics. Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Greenline Transport sells phone cases.

The booking app depends on the backup cluster. The jazz evening does not take place at the Sibiu Philharmonic. Also, the spring book fair does not take place at the Old Mill Hall. The Călărași Town Hall doesn't issue a work permit. Also, a driving licence is issued by the Leipzig Land Office. Alina intends to attend the town hall debate.

The photography workshop takes place at the Timișoara Philharmonic. Andreea plans to go to the code review session. Also, Erik Nilsen plans to go to the harvest festival. Atelier Bălan is a supplier of Bacău Logistics. Liam Smith treats Vlad.

Zalău Logistics employs Omar. Montreal Logistics does not carry sourdough bread. Nicolae Rusu isn't allergic to bee stings. Also, Zeynep has an allergy to strawberries. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Atelier Țurcanu sells garden furniture.

Adaeze Eze does not plan to study drawing. Also, Mr Iyer plans to study German. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Mr Gupta treats Mr Nguyễn. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Szeged Logistics is a supplier of Cahul Logistics.

Tănase & Partners is a supplier of Wagner & Partners. Ioana Pătrașcu doesn't go to the Plovdiv Language School. Mr Șerban goes to Botoșani Technical College.

Levente Tóth is a child of Zofia. Also, Ms Tanaka isn't a child of Enikő. Kaveh reports to Jun.

A few questions, then: Since Smaranda gets to work by bike, what does Teodora commute by? So how many documents does a building permit require? Please find out where Atelier Balogh is located. Here's what I know: Mr Kovács flies to Orhei; Wanjiru flies to Orhei; Mehmet flies to Orhei. Do you know if Ethan Walker does not fly to Orhei? Could you check if Paweł does not look after the VPN gateway? I wonder how Dorin goes to work.

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

It has been a hectic week on my side. Ștefania is the owner of the plot of land by the river and the bakery on the corner belongs to Ms Voicu. A work permit requires a criminal record certificate. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Mr Müller works under Parisa.

Carpathia Energy supplies Atelier Bălan and Brightfield Foods supplies Delta Print. Hyun-woo is the owner of the garage behind the block, and Mr Odhiambo is the owner of the old sailing boat. Esmeralda works under Mr Romero.

Katrin is not on Olimpia Ploiești; Aurelia plays for Olimpia Montreal. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Sânziana is the boss of Mr Clarke. The booking app depends on the payments gateway. Plus, the inventory API depends on the billing service. Rafael is the coach of Rapid Novi Sad, and Hassan coaches Rapid Tampere. Rémi is responsible for the search index.

Vaslui Logistics isn't based in Thessaloniki. Leeds Logistics carries olive oil. The wedding reception is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Plus, the spring book fair is held at the Old Mill Hall.

The backup cluster does not depend on the mail server. The jazz evening is held at the Constanța Philharmonic.

A few questions, then: I'm trying to find out who published A Short History of Bridges. Check this: Olena goes to the harvest festival. Tell me which team Anna-Lena is the coach of. Given that Emre teaches chemistry, does he teach chemistry? Verify the claim that a fire safety approval isn't issued by the Baia Mare Tax Office. Aditya was married to Haruka Sato from October 1, 2021 to November 1, 2024. He was the spouse of Haruka Sato on the 1st of October 2021, right?

message:
We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Larisa Enache has borrowed The Clockmaker's Daughter and Julien has borrowed The Glass Orchard. Wei takes part in the jazz evening.

Doina isn't the spouse of Yuki. Atelier Clarke published Winter in Maramureș. Ms Neagu is treated by Jonas. The booking app depends on the search index. Hyun-woo teaches biology and Lena teaches drawing. I hope you are having a good day.

Valentina travels to Baia Mare. Hughes & Partners carries printer ink. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Lagos Arts High School isn't in Montreal, and Bacău Music Academy is based in Slatina. It has been a hectic week on my side. The backup cluster relies on the payments gateway.

A driving licence requires a medical certificate. Plus, a building permit requires a criminal record certificate. The Tulcea Philharmonic hosts the spring book fair. Ananya plans to go to the photography workshop. Harry doesn't travel to Leeds. Plus, Liviu visits Suceava. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Atelier Popescu supplies Carpathia Energy. Kamau does not take part in the charity run, and Vlad goes to the code review session. The Chengdu Tax Office issues a fire safety approval, and a tax clearance certificate is issued by the Debrecen Tax Office. Camille works for Greenline Transport, and Emeka is employed by Dumitrescu & Partners. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Here is what I would like to check: How does Medeea commute? Moritz raises Tamás. Does Tamás raise Moritz? Quick one: where did Cătălin travel?

message:
Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Samuel is based in Ploiești. Vertex Analytics carries sourdough bread, and Glasgow Logistics carries second-hand laptops. Blue Harbor Media supplies Șerban & Partners. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush.

Traian plans to study mathematics. Delta Print supplies Brightfield Foods. Doina is married to Bogdan. A work permit requires an ID card. Let me give you some background first. Adaeze plans to go to the regional chess tournament; Andreea intends to attend the photography workshop.

Chloe is treated by Mr Toma, and Ms Ciobanu isn't the doctor of Oliver. Thảo isn't married to Rubina. Rohan takes part in the charity run. I hope you are having a good day. Ms Mwangi is based in Tulcea and Takumi Watanabe lives in Hanoi. Hiroshi is the doctor of Mr Clarke and Jun is the doctor of Hugo Lefèvre.

Beatriz Souza goes to the code review session. Orion Robotics doesn't carry baby food; Tisa Textiles carries herbal tea. The payments gateway doesn't rely on the booking app, and the backup cluster depends on the search index. Ms Iyer does not borrow Notes from the Night Train. Greenline Transport supplies Balogh & Partners; Carpathia Energy buys from Atelier Nagy.

Tamás gives classes in Spanish. A birth certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Montreal. Elena doesn't want to learn geography. Plus, Ovidiu wants to learn chemistry. Erik is married to Mr Oliveira.

Farkas & Partners sells bicycle parts and Neagu & Partners doesn't sell printer ink. The billing service depends on the inventory API. Mr Popescu has borrowed Letters to a Young Engineer. Chioma checked out The Glass Orchard. Ms Enache is based in Szeged.

The Old Mill Hall doesn't host the town hall debate. The VPN gateway relies on the reporting dashboard. The payroll database depends on the mail server. Plus, the analytics pipeline depends on the login service. Mykola doesn't intend to attend the parents' evening. Felix is on Valencia United.

Ji-woo doesn't raise Lena, and Gheorghe Căpraru is a parent of Dragoș. Schmidt & Partners published The Salt Road and Wright & Partners published Soups of Transylvania. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Rahul is based in Alba Iulia. Plus, Mr Nasser lives in Craiova.

Kaveh is the coach of Olimpia Lisbon, and Carmen Iordache coaches the Lisbon Wolves. Kostas teaches biology, and Simona Mureșan does not teach drawing. Jessica Smith travels to Kraków. Plus, Octavian visits Brașov.

Cătălin does not give classes in physics. Larissa is treated by Iurie. Vasile is the coach of the Slatina Falcons. Julien Martin lives in Oradea.

Raluca Crăciun is treated by Viorel Moldovan. Priya is allergic to peanuts and Cristina Oprea has an allergy to shellfish. Atelier Kovács carries olive oil. Dimitra is the coach of the Izmir Falcons and Roxana is the coach of the Pitești Wolves.

Rémi raises Hassan and Sânziana Munteanu is a parent of Rachel. Taras lives in Baia Mare. Ștefania Anghel is the spouse of Burak and Ms Mocanu is the spouse of Mr Stan.

Lisbon Logistics buys from Nagy & Partners.

A few questions, then: Background: Krzysztof manages Moritz. Question: I need to know if Moritz is the boss of Krzysztof. Out of curiosity, how many documents does the Târgu Mureș Land Office issue?

Thanks in advance!

message:
My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Ms Kim visits Lagos. A driving licence is issued by the Zalău Tax Office. The charity run is held at the Old Mill Hall. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Cătălin is a parent of Levente; Camille raises Javier Romero.

Mădălina Iordache is married to Mr Martínez. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Owen travels to Iași; Ms Sârbu travels to Chișinău. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Simona Crăciun is enrolled at Novi Sad Technical College, and Alina doesn't study at Târgu Mureș Technical College. Ms Tehrani does not maintain the billing service, and Andrei is not responsible for the booking app. The bakery on the corner does not belong to Burak. Mei Li is employed by Brightfield Foods; Ingrid has a job at Arad Logistics.

Delta Print supplies Blue Harbor Media. João lives in Tampere. Plus, Zeynep lives in Sibiu. Mr Reddy wants to learn history; Sofía plans to study Spanish.

A criminal record certificate is required for a work permit. Ms Martin travels to Deva. Aditya is not treated by Hiroshi. Plus, Ananya Patel is the doctor of Jürgen.

Liam lives in Nairobi. The photography workshop is held at the Porto Philharmonic. The red Dacia belongs to Tariq, and the recording studio belongs to Layla Saleh. Oksana travels to Szeged.

Vasile is based in Kraków. Ion gives classes in mathematics. A fire safety approval is issued by the Bacău Land Office and a tax clearance certificate is issued by the Leeds Land Office. It has been a hectic week on my side.

Mr Zhang is the doctor of Ioana and Roxana isn't the doctor of Jessica. Osaka Logistics supplies Wagner & Partners, and Greenline Transport buys from Gheorghiu & Partners. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Takumi has an allergy to peanuts.

Erik is a parent of Rafael Oliveira. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. The payments gateway relies on the reporting dashboard. Plus, the analytics pipeline relies on the VPN gateway. Atelier Nagy sells printer ink. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush.

Things I still have to do today:
- water the plants
- pay the phone bill
- return the library books

Kenji Suzuki was enrolled at Sighișoara Technical College on January 2, 2019? I was wondering whether Chloé does not study at Constanța Arts High School. What is the reason that Vlad is cleared for the lab?

I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Leeds Logistics carries herbal tea. Réka isn't treated by Can Demir. Pune Logistics carries olive oil. Plus, Dobre & Partners carries winter tyres. Tisa Textiles published The Quiet Harbour.

Diana is the doctor of Jun Zhang; Mykola is treated by Rafael. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Ionuț Dumitrescu gives classes in geography. The Tulcea Land Office doesn't issue an ID card.

Dragoș Stoica takes part in the jazz evening and Mateo Sánchez goes to the charity run. Astrid plans to study history, and Valentina plans to study biology. Xiaoling raises Ngozi.

A criminal record certificate is required for a driving licence and a building permit requires a medical certificate. A residence certificate is not issued by the Ploiești Land Office. Beatriz is the coach of the Botoșani Wolves. Plus, Daniel is the coach of the Nairobi Wolves. Quang Nguyễn does not go to the town hall debate.

Wanjiru has an allergy to bee stings. Plus, Enikő is allergic to peanuts. Paweł doesn't live in Târgu Mureș. Plus, Mr Kim is not based in Lagos.

Things I still have to do today:
- book the train tickets
- answer my emails
- buy groceries

A few questions, then: The garage behind the block doesn't belong to Paula? Out of curiosity, how many people work for Deva Logistics?

Cheers, and have a nice evening.

Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. The Iași Arena is based in Arad. Attila isn't enrolled at Wagner Primary School. The Clockmaker's Daughter was written by Mr Martínez and The Quiet Harbour was not written by Ion Rădulescu. I hope you are having a good day.

A driving licence is issued by the Suceava Tax Office. Simona doesn't borrow Letters to a Young Engineer. Ioana is the author of Notes from the Night Train; Wanjiru is the author of A Short History of Bridges. Olivia Bennett checked out The Last Ferry, and Zeynep does not borrow The Glass Orchard.

Mr Wright maintains the billing service. Plus, Chioma isn't responsible for the payments gateway. Omar Mansour does not travel to Pitești. The inventory API depends on the search index. Plus, the booking app relies on the backup cluster. Mr Andersen is not married to Kostas, and Vikram Sharma is the spouse of Priya Patel. Sânziana is employed by Carpathia Energy.

The Old Mill Hall hosts the code review session. Hannah is responsible for the login service, and Sofía is responsible for the mail server. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. The Sighișoara Arena hosts the town hall debate. Plus, the regional chess tournament is held at the Botanical Garden in Chișinău.

What I actually want to know:
Hypothetically, if Mr Varga is the coach of the Hanoi Falcons, is he the coach of the Hanoi Falcons?
I was wondering whether the Community Centre on Elm Street hosts the photography workshop.

message:
Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Atelier Varga supplies Orion Robotics. Jessica Taylor plans to study geography and Mateo plans to study drawing. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Medeea is a parent of Mr Smith. Zeynep goes to the regional chess tournament, and Hannah goes to the town hall debate. The Quiet Harbour was written by Linh. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Chloe has an allergy to ibuprofen. Vertex Analytics sells second-hand laptops, and Nordwind Systems sells printer ink. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me. Hiroshi lives in Nairobi; Vlad is based in Constanța. Łukasz does not coach the Lyon Falcons; Ștefania Crăciun is the coach of the Sibiu Wolves. Let me give you some background first.

Elif plays for Rapid Sighișoara. Daria doesn't live in Baia Mare. An ID card isn't required for a work permit. The backup cluster depends on the search index. Greenline Transport doesn't carry sourdough bread.

Achieng visits Ploiești, and Hugo travels to Oradea. Ayşe doesn't have a job at Munteanu & Partners. Irina visits Slatina.

A fire safety approval is issued by the Passport Office in Hanoi. Plus, a tax clearance certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Călărași.

Things I still have to do today:
- call the plumber
- finish the slides
- buy groceries
- water the plants
- return the library books

So, my questions:
So was Oana Ungureanu the coach of Rapid Debrecen during 2021?
Quick question: was Jürgen based in Zalău in 2020?
Can you tell me who is the spouse of Yuki?
Quick one: where was the harvest festival held?
Hi! Aditya is allergic to pollen, and Mădălina Lazăr is allergic to pollen, and Dorin Diaconu is allergic to pollen. I wonder if Liviu does not have an allergy to pollen.
Okay so Oluwaseun Adeyemi is the boss of Réka. Réka manages Oluwaseun Adeyemi, correct?

message:
Let me give you some background first. Priya plays for CS Tulcea. Plus, Hyun-woo plays for Chișinău United. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Rahul Gupta takes part in the spring book fair and Ana goes to the harvest festival.

Saint Luke Hospital isn't based in Sighișoara. Ms Șerban is treated by Rubina Lăutaru. I hope you are having a good day.

Chloé is the coach of Rapid Baia Mare. Plus, Kostas coaches CS Târgu Mureș. The Slatina Town Hall issues a work permit. Blue Harbor Media sells baby food. Ji-woo plans to go to the charity run. Katrin plans to study German.

The regional chess tournament is held at the Călărași Arena. Larisa coaches the Pitești Falcons, and Ovidiu coaches the Szeged Wolves. The payments gateway relies on the billing service. Plus, the payroll database doesn't rely on the login service. The Debrecen Tax Office does not issue a medical certificate. Levente has an allergy to penicillin, and Otieno has an allergy to latex. Paweł visits Nairobi; Mr Toma visits Alba Iulia.

Jun is on Rapid Botoșani. Ayşe manages Alina. Orion Robotics published Notes from the Night Train, and Atelier Ungureanu published The Quiet Harbour.

Smaranda is the spouse of Daria; Yuki Tanaka is married to Ingrid. Camille is the spouse of Krzysztof. Rémi teaches mathematics.

Can gives classes in drawing and Olena gives classes in geography. A residence certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Arad; the Tampere Tax Office issues a tax clearance certificate. Jack does not have a job at Carpathia Energy. A driving licence requires a criminal record certificate.

Turner & Partners supplies Cluj-Napoca Logistics and Debrecen Logistics buys from Valencia Logistics. Katalin has a job at Atelier Vlădescu. Plus, Irina Bălan works for Diaconu & Partners. The Passport Office in Piatra Neamț issues a fire safety approval. Owen raises Doina. I will try to keep the rest short.

Hiroshi Suzuki works for Atelier Weber. It has been a hectic week on my side. Atelier Nagy sells second-hand laptops; Focșani Logistics does not sell olive oil. The Tuesday board meeting is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Plus, the Szeged Arena hosts the parents' evening. Anca goes to the product launch.

Noah Wright works under Valentina. Brașov Logistics sells phone cases. Becker & Partners carries school uniforms.

Tatiana is married to Simona. Cosmin Crăciun travels to Kraków. Enikő works for Atelier Florea. Corina is treated by Tariq and Emeka is the doctor of Oliver.

Mr Gheorghiu visits Bistrița. The Constanța Philharmonic is in Bălți. Mocanu & Partners is based in Sibiu.

A few questions, then:
Verify the claim that Nordwind Systems does not carry herbal tea.
Could you check who is allergic to shellfish?
Do you know who Mădălina is married to?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

- book the train tickets
- return the library books
- water the plants

message:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Mr Bennett is the author of The Glass Orchard. Plus, The Clockmaker's Daughter was written by Maria. The Old Mill Hall is based in Zalău. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Seo-yeon is enrolled at the Tulcea Language School. Delta Print carries sourdough bread, and Nordwind Systems carries printer ink. Brightfield Foods sells second-hand laptops. Hiroshi Suzuki is the owner of the blue van. Plus, Dorin is not the owner of the old sailing boat.

Gheorghe visits Glasgow. Ingrid Nilsen is the coach of CS Szeged. Wanjiru doesn't intend to attend the harvest festival; Ioana doesn't intend to attend the code review session. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Octavian gives classes in German. Plus, Laura teaches Spanish. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Linh Phạm is enrolled at Lyon Arts High School and Constantin studies at Ardeleanu Primary School. The red Dacia belongs to Vasile and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Haruka.

Lin works under Dimitra; Doinița manages Léa Moreau. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Mr Çelik is treated by Jonas. Kamau is treated by Mr Guțu, and Zeynep is the doctor of Floarea. The weather here has been awful all week.

Larisa plans to study biology; Ion plans to study mathematics. The Botanical Garden in Botoșani is in Montreal. Plus, Plovdiv Music Academy is in Constanța. Lucía Navarro is treated by Layla. Cosmin Rusu raises Moritz.

Ștefania doesn't maintain the booking app. Liviu does not travel to Vaslui, and Małgorzata visits Lagos. The Botanical Garden in Novi Sad isn't in Leeds. I only have a few minutes before my next call. The billing service doesn't rely on the inventory API. Ms Manole is on Izmir United.

The Slatina Arena hosts the parents' evening. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. The garage behind the block belongs to Oana.

The Bergen Tax Office issues a work permit. Tatiana is on the Tampere Wolves. Burak Kaya is not on the Botoșani Wolves. Plus, Rafael is on Olimpia Târgu Mureș. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Hassan plans to study geography. A criminal record certificate is issued by the Bacău Tax Office. Andrei does not want to learn history. Baia Mare Logistics supplies Atelier Clarke and Toma & Partners does not buy from Atelier Barbu.

So, my questions: I was wondering whether Sofía coached Rapid Pune in 2021. Out of curiosity, where was the charity run held? Verify the claim that João is married to Roxana Munteanu. I'd like to know where Varga & Partners is.

Talk soon!

Chinedu Adeyemi is allergic to bee stings. Also, Zoltán has an allergy to lactose. A driving licence requires a birth certificate. Veaceslav trains the Lisbon Falcons. Kavya reports to Mirela. The jazz evening takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Also, the spring book fair does not take place at the Busan Philharmonic. Nadiya teaches drawing. Also, Lukas teaches history. The Oradea Land Office isn't located in Plovdiv. Atelier Șerban is a supplier of Pitești Logistics. Also, Balogh & Partners is a supplier of Blue Harbor Media.

Atelier Weber sells garden furniture. Also, Orion Robotics sells second-hand laptops. Oana attends the charity run. Also, Mr Johansson attends the harvest festival.

Kenji trains Rapid Constanța. Alexandru is not allergic to latex. The Chișinău Town Hall issues a land title extract. A medical certificate is issued by the Bistrița Land Office. Also, the Montreal Town Hall issues a residence certificate.

Manon doesn't play for the Kraków Falcons. Also, Moritz is not on Rapid Arad. Elena trains Rapid Lisbon. Also, Ms Căpraru trains Olimpia Vaslui. Mr Lazăr has an allergy to shellfish.

Mr Santos does not want to learn chemistry. Joaquín Martínez reports to Elif. Also, Yan reports to Florin. Dorin doesn't give classes in biology. Jun treats Petru.

A few questions, then: How come Owen doesn't have access to the lab? Not counting Chen, please find out who gives classes in piano. Here's what I know: Natalia Guțu attends the parents' evening; Zsófia Varga attends the parents' evening. Could you check if Tunde doesn't attend the parents' evening?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Costin is married to Rachel. Plus, Ananya is married to Mathieu. Takumi is based in Sibiu. Brightfield Foods sells olive oil. Plus, Țurcanu & Partners carries printer ink. Greenline Transport carries winter tyres.

Chioma Eze teaches history; Manon teaches drawing. Sighișoara Logistics does not buy from Iași Logistics. Mircea teaches mathematics. Felix is a parent of Tariq.

Anna-Lena Müller coaches Rapid Chișinău. Blue Harbor Media published Winter in Maramureș. Bianca goes to the spring book fair. Rohan is not a parent of Emeka and Brândușa isn't a parent of Cristina.

Pătrașcu & Partners published The Clockmaker's Daughter and Orion Robotics published Notes from the Night Train. The code review session is held at the Szeged Philharmonic. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. The Passport Office in Călărași issues an ID card.

Doinița Cebotari plays for Rapid Lviv, and Andreea is on CS Montreal. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. Jun isn't the owner of the red Dacia. Ilinca coaches Olimpia Tampere.

Erik works for Craiova Logistics. Plus, Dimitra is employed by Atelier Stan. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Joaquín is based in Botoșani. Lin gives classes in biology.

Ms Mocanu is based in Alba Iulia. Ștefania wants to learn physical education. Andrei is a parent of Medeea.

Aurelia is allergic to dust mites. Ms Souza is on the Baia Mare Falcons. Plus, Seo-yeon plays for CS Oradea. Daniel visits Brașov. Corina plans to go to the regional chess tournament. Laura plans to go to the wedding reception. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

The Passport Office in Oradea issues a medical certificate, and a criminal record certificate is not issued by the Passport Office in Osaka. Ayşe plans to go to the jazz evening. Traian Tănase takes part in the harvest festival. Cătălin is married to Victor. Suceava Logistics does not sell baby food. My coffee went cold while I was typing this.

The mail server relies on the login service. Plus, the VPN gateway depends on the analytics pipeline. Rémi does not coach the Reșița Wolves. A passport is issued by the Izmir Tax Office.

Mykola is treated by Emre and Layla is the doctor of Lucía. Hassan travels to Bălți. Priya works for Stan & Partners.

Montreal Logistics sells second-hand laptops. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Atelier Nagy carries bicycle parts and Alexandria Logistics sells sourdough bread. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me.

What I actually want to know: Honestly, is Georgiana Crăciun a parent of Chloe? Oliver gets the flu shot, and Samuel is vaccinated against the flu. So is Burak not vaccinated against the flu? I need to know if Jürgen teaches geography. Mr Saleh was based in Lyon on July 1, 2019, right? Besides Vasile Anghel, could you check who is the owner of the bakery on the corner?

Talk soon!

message:
The weather here has been awful all week. Ghiță flies to Piatra Neamț. Nour Mansour doesn't train Olimpia Galați.

Csaba doesn't train Reșița United. Also, Jack trains Olimpia Tulcea. Nils does not report to Bohdan. Cătălin Popescu wrote Soups of Transylvania. Also, Alexandru wrote Letters to a Young Engineer. Taras attends the product launch. Petronela is on Montreal United. Also, Răzvan isn't on CS Deva. Fatima does not own the blue van. Also, Karim owns the garage behind the block.

Diana wrote The Salt Road. Nordwind Systems is a supplier of Orion Robotics. The inventory API relies on the payments gateway.

Brightfield Foods does not carry garden furniture. The Old Mill Hall isn't located in Kraków. Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Xiaoling Wang owns the vineyard near Sibiu.

Paloma plans to go to the Tuesday board meeting. Also, Ion Neagu plans to go to the parents' evening. Thiago trains CS Busan. The Plovdiv Land Office issues a birth certificate. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Chinedu is allergic to latex. Also, Théo Moreau is allergic to penicillin. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Elif attends the regional chess tournament. Also, Léa attends the code review session. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Delta Print employs Élodie.

A land title extract is required for a passport. Iancu treats Daria. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Iulia wants to learn chemistry.

Min-jun attends the photography workshop. Otilia intends to attend the charity run. Also, Thảo intends to attend the wedding reception. Atelier Müller doesn't carry bicycle parts. The spring book fair takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street.

Aiko is allergic to lactose. Also, Moritz has an allergy to cat hair. Noah intends to attend the town hall debate. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Matei plays for CS Brașov. Georgiana teaches mathematics.

Bistrița Logistics is a supplier of Tulcea Logistics. Florică trains the Hanoi Falcons. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Rohan Sharma treats Tariq.

Hanoi Logistics is a supplier of Ciobanu & Partners. Thomas trains Bistrița United. Oana Constantinescu trains Rapid Brașov. Also, Camille trains Rapid Tulcea. Agnieszka trains Cluj-Napoca United. Also, Kavya trains Rapid Leeds. Botond Nagy doesn't report to Mehmet Şahin. Also, Layla reports to Réka.

Brown & Partners is a supplier of Tóth & Partners. Dragoș does not treat Emeka. Shirin is on Olimpia Călărași. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

A building permit isn't issued by the Galați Land Office. Aditya has an allergy to bee stings. Also, Quang Phạm has an allergy to ibuprofen. Liam trains the Suceava Falcons. Also, Kamau trains the Focșani Falcons. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Valentina Sánchez trains the Deva Falcons. Mădălina flies to Bălți. The Focșani Town Hall is located in Lisbon.

Things I still have to do today:
- book the train tickets
- finish the slides
- pay the phone bill
- water the plants
- call the plumber
- answer my emails

Now, what I need to know:
So where did Petru fly?
Fact-check: the login service doesn't depend on the mail server.

That is all the background I have for now.

    role object "the flu"
    polarity affirmed

  end

Let me give you some background first. Tisa Textiles sells phone cases. Timișoara Music Academy is located in Pitești.

Meera Sharma plays for Rapid Deva. Also, Florin is on Rapid Alexandria. Piatra Neamț Logistics published The Salt Road. Carpathia Energy published Soups of Transylvania. A passport requires a birth certificate. Matei doesn't plan to go to the product launch. Also, Ildikó doesn't plan to go to the parents' evening. I hope you are having a good day.

Megan is a child of Parisa. Also, Ms Sánchez is a child of Aurelia. Emma Smith looks after the analytics pipeline. Also, Zoltán looks after the billing service. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Diego is allergic to lactose.

The reporting dashboard depends on the VPN gateway. It has been a hectic week on my side. The Passport Office in Chengdu issues a land title extract. Also, a driving licence is issued by the Passport Office in Lisbon. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask.

Ms Fekete does not look after the mail server. Also, Wojciech looks after the search index. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. A residence certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Pune. Teodora attends the Tuesday board meeting. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. Florică Lăutaru treats Mr Martínez. Also, Aiko treats Liviu.

Atelier Wright sells LED bulbs. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here.

A few questions, then:
I wonder how Ji-woo goes to work.
Not counting Răzvan, please find out who plays for CS Buzău.
